Name: Pixel Waifu Ripening - HD Pixel Portraits
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff66b2]Pixel Waifu Ripening[/color][/b][/size]
[i]A Portrait Overhaul brought to you by the Turtle Hermit Himself![/i][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#ff9933]Greetings, my boy![/color][/b][/size]
Oh ho ho! Have you been training hard in Pelican Town? Tilling the fields, chopping the wood, and... admiring the scenery? Well, Master Roshi has been doing a little "research" of his own, and I've put together a spectacular collection for you! I call it... [b]Pixel Waifu Ripening![/b]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ff9933]The Beauties of Pelican Town[/color][/b][/size]
Right now, this collection focuses strictly on the classic beauties—the vanilla bachelorettes! I'm holding off on those wild Valley Girls and Harem Valley additions for now. You've got to master the basics before we move on to the advanced "Puff-Puff" techniques, right?!

Here is who you get to marvel at in glorious High-Definition:
[list]
[*][b]Abigail[/b] - A girl who likes exploring dark caves... oh my![/*]
[*][b]Caroline[/b] - She loves her green tea, but she's bringing the heat![/*]
[*][b]Emily[/b] - Oh, the mystical aura on this one![/*]
[*][b]Haley[/b] - The blonde bombshell![/*]
[*][b]Jodi[/b] - This dedicated housewife is looking for a new kind of workout![/*]
[*][b]Leah[/b] - An artist who truly appreciates the human form![/*]
[*][b]Maru[/b] - Brains and beauty![/*]
[*][b]Penny[/b] - Sweet, innocent, and oh-so-lovely![/*]
[*][b]Robin[/b] - A master carpenter who really knows her way around hardwood!
[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ff9933]Special Wardrobe Changes![/color][/b][/size]
A true master knows that a lady's wardrobe changes with the weather and the time of day! *wipes bloody nose* I've spared no expense in capturing them in all their different states:
[list]
[*][b]Pyjamas:[/b] Catch them early in the morning or late at night, and they'll be wearing their sleepwear! Perfect for a late-night visit, eh?![/*]
[*][b]Rain Gear:[/b] When the skies open up, they'll be dressed appropriately for the wet weather.[/*]
[*][b]The Cold Shoulder:[/b] If you haven't won Haley's heart yet (0 to 3 hearts), she won't even look at you! She'll just ignore you and stare at her phone. Kids these days... you gotta put in the work and earn her attention![/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Strict Training Requirements (IMPORTANT!)[/color][/b][/size]
Listen closely now, because if you mess this up, it'll blow up in your face like a misfired Kamehameha!
This mod is built EXCLUSIVELY to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]DDFC[/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43364]APF[/url]. It uses custom grid math to handle the HD sizes, auto-padding, and outfits. You must have DDFC and APF installed, or these beautiful portraits won't load right! Don't try to use other portrait frameworks with this to avoid a UI cage match!


[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ff9933]Future Updates[/color][/b][/size]
Patience, my eager student! The Turtle Hermit is pacing himself.
This is just the initial release, featuring the six primary vanilla Waifus.
I still have some polishing to do! (Also not all of them have rain alts yet eh eh)

I have some plans and Ideas for this project, so here is a

[b]To-Do list:[/b]
[list]
[*][s]Create Rain variants for the existing sprites.[/s][/*]
[*]Make patches for Harem Valley/Valley Girls, Xtardew and Lewddew Valley[/*]
[*]Have different poses for different mood reactions[/*]
[*]See if it is possible to add event specific portraits for even more immersion[/*]
[*]Cover ALL vanilla characters[/*]
[*]Add idle animations to portraits[/*]
[/list]

We will get to the advanced material later. For now, enjoy these six vanilla beauties and let them inspire your daily farming!
Now go! Install the mod, visit the ladies, and remember your training! Oh ho ho ho!
